Definition: Zebulon, a son of Jacob; also his territory and tribe
BiblicalUsage: Zebulun is the tenth son of Jacob and the sixth of Leah, born when Leah believed God had given her a good dowry and her husband would finally dwell with her. Jacob blesses him as a tribe that will dwell by the sea, a haven for ships, and Moses blesses him again, calling him to rejoice in his going out. His tribe settles in the north, in the hill country of Galilee, and the land itself takes his name.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zebulun's story is a quiet one, and that is the point: not every tribe leads the nation, and faithfulness in a small place still counts. The blessing on his going out covers ordinary work, ordinary travel, and ordinary life.
